responsibility: This implementation module provides the main legacy text I/O layer for GNU Modula-2. It tracks the current input and output FIO files, routes character I/O through Terminal and dynamically installs LocalRead/LocalWrite handlers into Termbase, performs token-based string and number parsing with DynamicStrings and StringConvert helpers, and formats numeric output to the active stream while maintaining the module-level Done status.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the InOut pair: it installs local read/write handlers, manages current input/output files, and performs the actual text parsing and formatting, whereas InOut.def is the exported interface.
